plugins.name: blender
plugins.description: Blender 3D modeling skill: plan → build with a tested bpy helper kit → self-check geometry → render → review → deliver a .blend that opens in colour.
plugins.longDescription: 让 Agent 用 Blender 生成可交付的 3D 模型：先列部件清单，再用经过验证的 bpy 工具库建模（正确的尺寸语义、带视口颜色的材质、门窗/屋顶/门廊/庭院部件、自动取景相机与灯光），结构自检、渲染预览并逐轮修正，最终交付打开即彩色的 .blend 和预览图。需要本机安装 Blender 4.2+。
defaultPrompt: 在 Blender 里做一个两层的温馨小屋，带门廊、烟囱和小花园
用 Blender 建一个低多边形的咖啡杯产品展示场景并渲染
做一个简单的房间布局模型：床、书桌、衣柜、窗户

skills.name: blender-modeling
skills.description: Build presentable 3D models, dioramas and product scenes in Blender with bpy scripts — plan the parts, build with the tested ofx_blender_kit helpers, self-check geometry, render a preview, look at it, iterate, then deliver a .blend that opens in colour.

en.longDescription: Let the agent produce deliverable 3D models in Blender: plan the parts, build with a tested bpy helper kit (correct size semantics, viewport-visible materials, windows/roofs/porches/garden props, auto-framed camera and lights), self-check the geometry, render previews and iterate, then deliver a .blend that opens in colour. Requires Blender 4.2+ on this machine.
defaultPrompt: Build a two-storey cozy cottage in Blender with a porch, chimney and a small garden
Model a low-poly coffee mug product scene in Blender and render it
Make a simple room layout: bed, desk, wardrobe, window

plugins.name: hyperframes
plugins.description: Write HTML, render video. Compositions, GSAP animations, captions, voiceovers, audio-reactive visuals, and website-to-video capture for HyperFrames.
plugins.longDescription: Build videos from HTML with HyperFrames. Author compositions with HTML + CSS + GSAP, use the CLI for init/preview/render/transcribe/tts, install reusable registry blocks and components, follow the GSAP animation reference, and turn any website into a video with the 7-step capture-to-video pipeline.
defaultPrompt: Turn this website into a 20-second product promo
Create an animated title card with kinetic type
Add synced captions to this voiceover

skills.name: gsap
skills.description: GSAP animation reference for HyperFrames. Covers gsap.to(), from(), fromTo(), easing, stagger, defaults, timelines (gsap.timeline(), position parameter, labels, nesting, playback), and performance (transforms, will-change, quickTo). Use when writing GSAP animations in HyperFrames compositions.

skills.name: hyperframes
skills.description: Create video compositions, animations, title cards, overlays, captions, voiceovers, audio-reactive visuals, and scene transitions in HyperFrames HTML. Use when asked to build any HTML-based video content, add captions or subtitles synced to audio, generate text-to-speech narration, create audio-reactive animation (beat sync, glow, pulse driven by music), add animated text highlighting (marker sweeps, hand-drawn circles, burst lines, scribble, sketchout), or add transitions between scenes (crossfades, wipes, reveals, shader transitions). Covers composition authoring, timing, media, and the full video production workflow. For CLI commands (init, lint, preview, render, transcribe, tts) see the hyperframes-cli skill.

skills.name: hyperframes-cli
skills.description: HyperFrames CLI tool — hyperframes init, lint, inspect, preview, render, transcribe, tts, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, compositions, docs, benchmark. Use when scaffolding a project, linting, validating, inspecting visual layout in compositions, previewing in the studio, rendering to video, transcribing audio, generating TTS, or troubleshooting the HyperFrames environment.

skills.name: hyperframes-registry
skills.description: Install and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add, installing a block or component, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers the add command, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and registry discovery.

skills.name: website-to-hyperframes
skills.description: Capture a website and create a HyperFrames video from it. Use when: (1) a user provides a URL and wants a video, (2) someone says "capture this site", "turn this into a video", "make a promo from my site", (3) the user wants a social ad, product tour, or any video based on an existing website, (4) the user shares a link and asks for any kind of video content. Even if the user just pastes a URL — this is the skill to use.

zh.shortDescription: 用 HTML 写视频，代码渲染成片
zh.description: 用 HTML + CSS + GSAP 编写视频合成，渲染成视频。覆盖 GSAP 动画、字幕、配音、音频律动视觉，以及把网站录制成视频。
zh.longDescription: 用 HyperFrames 从 HTML 生成视频：以 HTML + CSS + GSAP 编写合成，用 CLI 完成初始化 / 预览 / 渲染 / 转写 / 配音，安装可复用的组件块，参考 GSAP 动画规范，并可通过 7 步流程把任意网站转成视频。
defaultPrompt: 把这个网站做成一段 20 秒的产品宣传视频
做一个带动态文字的动画标题卡
给这段配音加上同步字幕

plugins.name: remotion

plugins.longDescription: Build videos programmatically with Remotion and React. Covers animations, timing, audio, captions, 3D, transitions, charts, text effects, and more.
defaultPrompt: Create an animated chart with 5 bars
Make an animated call-to-action subscribe button for our YouTube channel
Use Remotion to add captions and audio to a video composition.

skills.name: remotion-markup
skills.description: Content, animation and effects best practices

zh.description: Remotion 视频制作技能：最佳实践、动画、音频、字幕、3D 等，用 React 以编程方式生成视频。
zh.longDescription: 用 Remotion 和 React 以编程方式制作视频，涵盖动画、时序、音频、字幕、3D、转场、图表、文字特效等。
defaultPrompt: 做一个 5 根柱子的动画图表
为我们的 YouTube 频道做一个动态的「订阅」号召按钮
用 Remotion 给一段视频合成加上字幕和音频
